rows.claim: The agent can rerun the two commands and the verifier once either is resolved.
rows.evidence: The agent already ran both opsctl commands (T0B7/T0B8) and checks/verify.py (T0B9/T0B10) successfully in the sandbox, so it plainly has the tools and access to rerun them. The commands returned errors due to blockers (409 and 403), not tool unavailability. Whether a blocker is later resolved is a future condition, but the ability to rerun is shown by the tool outputs.
